Checking the production trace for the failing order.

Root cause: billing/currency.py:88 converts to float and uses Python's round(), which does banker's rounding (round half to even) on a binary float, so 10.005 EUR becomes 1001 minor units. The trace trc_9f2a71 shows exactly this. Fix: use Decimal(str(amount)).quantize(..., rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP) inside to_minor_units, which keeps the public API unchanged.
Proposed change #3 to billing/currency.py (pending the user's approval; not yet applied).
I also suggest proposal #4: refactor currency helpers into a Money class.
Proposed change #4 to billing/money.py (pending the user's approval; not yet applied).
Applied #3. Rejected #4: keep the diff minimal this sprint. Run the whole suite.
